entries.en:
Tazel Meyean has asked you to craft for him four high-quality starboard wing components for the Dezul Qualan. In order to obtain the requisite materials, you must first gather fifteen pristine oak branches and five pristine oak logs in the vicinity of Proud Creek.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.

entries.en: Ooh, yet another curious collection of odds and ends, and a goodly amount besides. So that they don't get in your way while you work, I'll hold on to any excess materials until you need them. The crafting space is ready for your use. You may begin whenever you like.
entries.fr: Et voilà, tout est prêt !! C'est à toi de jouer, maintenant. Si jamais il y a un problème, pas de souci, viens me voir et je m'occuperai de tout.

entries.en: Finished crafting, have you? Well, don't keep the client waiting─run along and deliver your handiwork! Now, I doubt that you'd be so clumsy as to misplace your precious creations, but on the off chance that you do, know that I still have the excess materials in my keeping.
entries.fr: Ça y est, tu as fini ta petite cuisine ? Alors n'attends pas et va vite livrer ton commanditaire pendant que c'est encore chaud !
entries.ja:
仕事が終わった子は、納品に行かなきゃだめだぞ～！
途中でなくしちゃったりしたら、
お姉さんのところにまた来て、作りなおせばいいからねっ！

entries.en: Squawk! Precisely to specifications, they are! Most impressed, I am! With my genius and your deft hands, to infinity and beyond, we will go!
